credits.title: Aroma
credits.overview: Yang, a nurse with an unusually selective sense of smell, can tolerate only disinfectant and lemon—until she encounters the scent of Fang, a man in a vegetative state. As she imagines her way into his memories, guilt and forbidden desires, the boundaries between intimacy, projection and death begin to dissolve. Moving

credits.title: Boiling Point
credits.overview: A bar regular is forced to prove he can drink boiling water, but after a freak accident, he unexpectedly rises to citywide fame as the legendary “Hot Water Master.”

credits.title: Take Off
credits.overview: A worker from Northeast China is obsessed with his dream of flying his self-made flying-device.

credits.title: Friday, Funfair
credits.overview: A woman's life begins to break apart as her husband decides to leave, her child prepares for surgery, and her mother begins to age.

credits.title: His Redemption
credits.overview: Middle-aged Liu Mu, worn down by relentless work and life pressure, stumbles into a private realm of his own—a space that becomes his spiritual anchor. There, he endlessly reconnects and "converses" with his past, encountering people and events that feel eerily familiar, each seemingly tied to his own history

credits.title: Who is Sleeping in Silver Grey
credits.overview: Cheng Die is a young music teacher living in a small town. Following an affair with a married man, she loses her job and has to leave town. She finds herself on an isolated island whose inhabitants cannot speak and where nothing is what it seems. She gets immersed in a dreamy experience.

credits.title: A Chat
credits.overview: Gu Qing bid farewell to the past and runs a tailor shop in a small southern city. She has a not-so-loving lover and a repetitive daily life. Her niece, Sun Yue, who she had only met when she was a child, comes to live with her and learn tailoring craftsmanship.

credits.title: 160 Years Old
credits.overview: A father who cannot cure his own stubborn illness, a professor mother who struggles with existential questions, a son who is confused and precocious, a giant tortoise that suddenly leaves, and a sentimental grandfather who passed away. The uncle cannot finish reading THE OLD MAN AND THE SEA. The aunt won't get married.

credits.title: Tracing Her Shadow
credits.overview: An old Chinese woman visits Japan to find her missing daughter whom she adopted in post-WWII China. Her granddaughter and a retired Japanese policeman join her search.

credits.title: Voice of the Nation
credits.overview: Based on the story of the folk musician Nie Er and the creation of "The March of the Volunteers", national anthem of the People's Republic of China.

credits.title: The Taste of Rice Flower
credits.overview: Ye Nan, a mother belonging to the Dai minority, comes back to her village after living in the city. She wants to take care of the 13-year-old daughter she'd left behind, but the road to rebuilding their relationship is full of obstacles.

credits.title: Underground Fragrance
credits.overview: The lives of three people entwine in Beijing's Underground City.
